title: Micron CEO Says Memory Supply Will Be Much Tighter in 2027 and 2028 Than in 2026
summary: Micron's CEO warns that memory supply will be significantly tighter in 2027 and 2028 compared to 2026, driven by surging AI datacenter demand for HBM and DRAM. The Hacker News discussion (367 points, 420 comments) debates implications for AI hardware costs, GPU availability, and the broader compute supply chain.
